--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta correctly fixes the prior release-evidence blocker and nine-key config-contract sync, and adds real drill/HIL mechanisms for AC-3/AC-4 — but leaves FR verification/traceability rows, coverage failure cases, evidence shas, and reviewer independence unsynced, so several prior dispositions are not actually evidenced.
  Top risks: test_matrix depends on undeclared scripts (scope drift), and HIL/cost-envelope approval remains unrecorded while open questions were cleared rather than closed with evidence.
